blocks.text: will: kelajak haqida fakt va taxmin

O'zbek tilida kelajakni ko'pincha «-adi / -aman» shakli bilan aytamiz: «Kelasi oy o'ttiz yoshga **to'laman**», «Menimcha, u **keladi**», «Xavotir olma, hammasi yaxshi **bo'ladi**». Ingliz tilida bunday gaplar uchun **will** + V1 ishlatiladi. will — kelajakda bo'ladigan **fakt** yoki biz o'ylaydigan, ishonadigan, kutadigan narsa (**taxmin**). Lekin oldindan tuzilgan reja va niyat uchun will emas, Present Continuous yoki going to kerak (→ 25–26-darslar).

**will** barcha shaxslar uchun bir xil: I will, she will, they will — `-s` qo'shilmaydi. Undan keyin fe'l doim **V1** — «will goes», «will to go» emas. So'zlashuvda qisqa shakl **'ll** ishlatiladi: I'll, you'll, it'll. Inkor: will not = **won't**. So'roqda will egadan oldinga chiqadi: **Will** you be ...? Qisqa javob: Yes, I **will**. / No, it **won't**.

will bilan kelajakdagi oddiy faktlarni aytamiz: yosh, sana, kim qayerda bo'lishi, ob-havo va tabiat hodisalari. Ayniqsa **will be** juda ko'p uchraydi: I'll be at work, It'll be dark, He'll be ten. O'zbekchada: «bo'laman», «to'ladi», «qorong'i tushadi».

items.text: This time next week **we'll be** in London.
The baby **will be** one year old on Sunday.

blocks.text: Taxmin: I think ... will, I don't think ... will

Kelajak haqidagi fikrimizni will bilan aytamiz va ko'pincha oldiga **I think**, **I'm sure**, **I expect** qo'shamiz yoki **probably** («ehtimol») ishlatamiz. Inkor fikrda inglizlar «I think he won't come» dan ko'ra **I don't think he'll come** deyishni afzal ko'radi — o'zbekchadagi «keladi deb o'ylamayman» ga o'xshaydi. **probably** will dan keyin, won't dan esa oldin turadi: he'll **probably** come / he **probably** won't come.

rows: He**'ll probably be** late. / He **probably won't** come.

items.text: **I'm sure** it**'ll be** a great party.
**I don't think** the shop **will be** open.

blocks.text: Britaniya inglizchasida **I** va **we** bilan will o'rniga **shall** ham ishlatiladi: I **shall** be late = I**'ll** be late. Ma'nosi bir xil, faqat shall rasmiyroq eshitiladi va bugun kamroq uchraydi — ko'proq rasmiy xat, nutq va e'lonlarda. Inkori — **shan't** (= won't). he, she, it, you, they bilan faqat **will**. shall ning eng ko'p ishlatiladigan joyi — taklif va maslahat so'rash: Shall I ...? Shall we ...? (→ 28-dars).

items.text: **I shall** write to you next week.

blocks.text: will, going to yoki Present Continuous?

will — «kelasi zamonning yagona shakli» emas. Agar reja allaqachon kelishilgan yoki qaror oldin qilingan bo'lsa, will ishlatilmaydi: «Tonight I will meet Tom» emas — **I'm meeting** Tom tonight. Bashoratda ham farq bor: hozir ko'rinib turgan dalilga qarab — **going to** (Look at the clouds — it's going to rain), shunchaki fikr va ishonch — **will** (I think it'll rain tomorrow).

rows: I**'m going to** sell my car.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I will to go.» → **I'll go.**; «She will goes.» → **She will go.**; «I will be 25 years.» → **I'll be 25.**; «I think he won't come.» → tabiiyrog'i **I don't think he'll come.**; kelishilgan reja haqida «Will you go to the cinema tonight?» → **Are you going to the cinema tonight?**
Eslab qolish: o'zbekcha «**menimcha ... -adi**», «**-sa kerak**», «**ishonchim komil**» → **will**. «**-moqchiman**» → going to. «**ertaga ...-yapman**» (kelishilgan) → Present Continuous.
will ning boshqa vazifalari — gapirish paytida qabul qilingan qaror, taklif va va'da (I'll carry it for you) hamda Shall I ...? / Shall we ...? — 28-darsda. there will be — 38-darsda.

examples.title: **will** / **'ll**: facts about the future
examples.description: Kelajakda bo'ladigan fakt: **will** + V1, qisqa shakl **'ll**. O'zbekchada: «-adi», «-aman», «bo'ladi».

sentences.text: My son **will be** ten years old in May.
sentences.translation: O'g'lim mayda o'n **yoshga to'ladi**.

sentences.text: This time tomorrow **I'll be** in Samarkand with my family.
sentences.translation: Ertaga shu vaqtda oilam bilan Samarqandda **bo'laman**.

sentences.text: The new metro station **will open** next spring.
sentences.translation: Yangi metro bekati kelasi bahorda **ochiladi**.

sentences.text: It's nearly six — it**'ll be** dark soon.
sentences.translation: Soat oltiga yaqin — tez orada **qorong'i tushadi**.

sentences.text: Don't call Aziz now; he**'ll be** at work until five.
sentences.translation: Hozir Azizga qo'ng'iroq qilmang — u soat beshgacha **ishda bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: Next year we**'ll celebrate** our twenty-fifth wedding anniversary.
sentences.translation: Kelasi yili turmushimizning yigirma besh yilligini **nishonlaymiz**.

sentences.text: Sarah **will finish** university in two years, and then she wants to travel.
sentences.translation: Sara ikki yildan keyin universitetni **tugatadi**, keyin sayohat qilmoqchi.

sentences.text: The shops **will be** closed on Monday because it's a public holiday.
sentences.translation: Dushanba kuni do'konlar **yopiq bo'ladi**, chunki bu davlat bayrami.

sentences.text: Hurry up, or you**'ll miss** your train!
sentences.translation: Shoshiling, aks holda poyezdingizdan **qolib ketasiz**!

sentences.text: The fast train is great: you**'ll be** in Bukhara in less than four hours.
sentences.translation: Tezyurar poyezd ajoyib: to'rt soatga qolmay Buxoroda **bo'lasiz**.

sentences.text: Don't worry, the injection **won't hurt**.
sentences.translation: Xavotir olmang, ukol **og'ritmaydi**.

sentences.text: I **won't be** at home tomorrow afternoon.
sentences.translation: Ertaga tushdan keyin uyda **bo'lmayman**.

sentences.text: Madina **won't be** at the party — she's visiting her grandmother.
sentences.translation: Madina ziyofatda **bo'lmaydi** — u buvisinikiga boryapti.

sentences.text: This old phone **won't last** much longer.
sentences.translation: Bu eski telefon uzoqqa **bormaydi**.

sentences.text: We **won't have** enough chairs for everyone, so I'm going to borrow some.
sentences.translation: Hammaga stul **yetmaydi**, shuning uchun bir nechtasini qarzga olib turmoqchiman.

sentences.text: The exam **won't be** easy, but you've studied a lot.
sentences.translation: Imtihon oson **bo'lmaydi**, lekin siz ko'p o'qidingiz.

sentences.text: Prices **won't go** down this year — they never do.
sentences.translation: Bu yil narxlar **tushmaydi** — ular hech qachon tushmaydi.

sentences.text: Without a visa, they **won't let** you on the plane.
sentences.translation: Vizasiz sizni samolyotga **chiqarishmaydi**.

sentences.text: Grandad **won't hear** you — speak louder!
sentences.translation: Bobom sizni **eshitmaydi** — balandroq gapiring!

sentences.text: Shh, don't wake the baby — she **won't go** back to sleep.
sentences.translation: Shh, chaqaloqni uyg'otmang — keyin **qayta uxlamaydi**.

examples.title: Questions: **Will** it ...? — Yes, it **will**.
examples.description: So'roq: **Will** + ega + V1? Qisqa javob: Yes, I will. / No, it won't. So'roq so'z bilan: When **will** ...? Where **will** ...?

sentences.text: **Will** you **be** at home this evening? — Yes, I will.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun uyda **bo'lasizmi**? — Ha, bo'laman.

sentences.text: When **will** the results **be** ready? — On Friday, I think.
sentences.translation: Natijalar qachon **tayyor bo'ladi**? — Menimcha, juma kuni.

sentences.text: **Will** the journey **take** long? — No, only about an hour.
sentences.translation: Yo'l uzoq **davom etadimi**? — Yo'q, bir soatcha.

sentences.text: How old **will** your grandmother **be** on her next birthday?
sentences.translation: Keyingi tug'ilgan kunida buvingiz necha **yoshga to'ladi**?

sentences.text: Where **will** you **be** at six o'clock tomorrow?
sentences.translation: Ertaga soat oltida qayerda **bo'lasiz**?

sentences.text: **Will** Emma **get** the job, do you know?
sentences.translation: Emmani ishga **olishadimi**, bilasizmi?

sentences.text: What time **will** we **arrive** in Manchester? — At about half past four.
sentences.translation: Manchesterga soat nechada **yetib boramiz**? — Taxminan to'rt yarimda.

sentences.text: How cold **will** it **be** in Moscow in March? — Quite cold, probably.
sentences.translation: Martda Moskvada qanchalik **sovuq bo'ladi**? — Ehtimol, ancha sovuq.

sentences.text: Who **will look** after the children while we're away?
sentences.translation: Biz yo'qligimizda bolalarga kim **qaraydi**?

sentences.text: Why **will** the museum **be** closed next week? — They're repairing the roof.
sentences.translation: Kelasi hafta muzey nega **yopiq bo'ladi**? — Tomini ta'mirlashyapti.

examples.title: Opinions: **I think** ... **will**, **I don't think** ...
examples.description: Kelajak haqida fikr: I think / I'm sure / I expect / probably + **will**. Inkor fikr: **I don't think** ... will. O'zbekchada: «menimcha ... -adi», «ishonchim komil», «-sa kerak».

sentences.text: **I think** Madina **will win** the competition — she's very talented.
sentences.translation: **Menimcha**, tanlovda Madina **g'olib bo'ladi** — u juda iqtidorli.

sentences.text: Honestly, **I don't think** it**'ll rain** tomorrow.
sentences.translation: Rostini aytsam, ertaga yomg'ir **yog'adi deb o'ylamayman**.

sentences.text: You**'ll love** Samarkand, **I'm sure** — it's beautiful.
sentences.translation: Samarqand sizga albatta **yoqadi**, **ishonchim komil** — u juda chiroyli.

sentences.text: Bekzod **will probably be** late — he always is.
sentences.translation: Bekzod **kechiksa kerak** — u doim kechikadi.

sentences.text: **Do you think** the price of petrol **will go** up again?
sentences.translation: **Sizningcha**, benzin narxi yana **oshadimi**?

sentences.text: Don't invite James — he **probably won't come**.
sentences.translation: Jeymsni taklif qilmang — u **kelmasa kerak**.

sentences.text: **I expect** we**'ll get** home around midnight.
sentences.translation: Uyga yarim tunlarda **yetib borsak kerak**.

sentences.text: Sarah has studied hard, so **I'm sure** she**'ll pass**.
sentences.translation: Sara qattiq o'qidi, shuning uchun **ishonchim komil**, u imtihondan **o'tadi**.

sentences.text: In fifty years, **I think** people **will live** on the moon.
sentences.translation: Ellik yildan keyin, **menimcha**, odamlar Oyda **yashaydi**.

sentences.text: **I don't think** Grandma **will like** this music — it's too loud.
sentences.translation: Bu musiqa buvimga **yoqadi deb o'ylamayman** — juda baland.

examples.title: **I shall** / **we shall**: formal British English
examples.description: Britaniyada **I** va **we** bilan will o'rniga **shall** ham ishlatiladi: I **shall** be ... = I**'ll** be .... Bu rasmiyroq; inkori — **shan't**. he, she, they bilan — faqat **will**.

sentences.text: **I shall be** in my office all day on Thursday.
sentences.translation: Payshanba kuni kun bo'yi ofisimda **bo'laman**.

sentences.text: We **shall** never **forget** your kindness.
sentences.translation: Mehribonligingizni hech qachon **unutmaymiz**.

sentences.text: **I shan't be** long — just five minutes.
sentences.translation: **Ko'p qolib ketmayman** — besh daqiqa xolos.

sentences.text: Dear Mr Brown, we **shall be** happy to answer any questions.
sentences.translation: Hurmatli janob Braun, har qanday savolingizga javob berishdan **mamnun bo'lamiz**.

sentences.text: Tomorrow we **shall** discuss the new timetable.
sentences.translation: Ertaga yangi dars jadvalini **muhokama qilamiz**.

sentences.text: As your new director, **I shall** do my best for this school.
sentences.translation: Yangi direktoringiz sifatida bu maktab uchun qo'limdan kelganini **qilaman**.

sentences.text: We **shan't** need the car tomorrow — take it if you want.
sentences.translation: Ertaga bizga mashina **kerak bo'lmaydi** — xohlasangiz, oling.

sentences.text: The children **will be** tired after the trip.
sentences.translation: Safardan keyin bolalar **charchagan bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: Ladies and gentlemen, we **shall** land in Tashkent in twenty minutes.
sentences.translation: Xonimlar va janoblar, yigirma daqiqadan keyin Toshkentga **qo'namiz**.

sentences.text: My grandfather always says, "I **shall** live to a hundred!"
sentences.translation: Bobom doim «Yuzga **kiraman**!» deydi.

examples.title: **will** or **going to**? Belief or plan
examples.description: will — fikr, ishonch, fakt; going to — niyat yoki ko'rinib turgan dalil; Present Continuous — kelishilgan reja. Kelishilgan reja uchun will ishlatilmaydi.

sentences.text: **I think** it**'ll be** sunny at the weekend.
sentences.translation: **Menimcha**, dam olish kunlari havo **ochiq bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: Look at the sky — **it's going to** be a lovely day.
sentences.translation: Osmonga qarang — kun ajoyib **bo'ladiganga o'xshaydi**.

sentences.text: We**'re having** dinner with the Browns on Friday — they invited us last week.
sentences.translation: Juma kuni Braunlar oilasi bilan **kechki ovqatga boramiz** — ular bizni o'tgan hafta taklif qilishdi.

sentences.text: **I'm going to** paint my room green.
sentences.translation: Xonamni yashil rangga **bo'yamoqchiman**.

sentences.text: Green? Your mother **won't like** that!
sentences.translation: Yashilgami? Bu onangizga **yoqmaydi**!

sentences.text: Tom **is flying** to Edinburgh on Sunday; he's already got his ticket.
sentences.translation: Tom yakshanba kuni Edinburgga **uchadi**; chiptasini allaqachon olgan.

sentences.text: He**'ll be** tired after a week of meetings, I expect.
sentences.translation: Bir hafta majlislardan keyin u **charchagan bo'ladi**, menimcha.

sentences.text: Aziz **is going to** cook plov for everyone tonight — he's bought all the meat.
sentences.translation: Aziz bugun kechqurun hammaga palov **damlamoqchi** — go'shtni ham olib qo'ydi.

sentences.text: It**'ll be** delicious — his plov is always the best.
sentences.translation: Mazali **bo'ladi** — uning palovi doim eng zo'ri.

sentences.text: Mum, I**'m meeting** Emma at the café at four, and **I don't think** I**'ll be** back before seven.
sentences.translation: Oyi, soat to'rtda kafeda Emma bilan **uchrashaman**, yettidan oldin **qaytaman deb o'ylamayman**.

examples.title: Dialogue: what will the interview be like?
examples.description: Dialog: Madina ertangi ish suhbatidan xavotirda, Sara uni tinchlantiradi. will — taxmin va fakt; I'm sure / I don't think / Do you think ... will?

sentences.text: — My interview is at ten tomorrow. **Will** it **be** very difficult?
sentences.translation: — Suhbatim ertaga soat o'nda. U juda **qiyin bo'ladimi**?

sentences.text: — **I don't think** so. They**'ll ask** about your studies and your last job.
sentences.translation: — **Unday deb o'ylamayman**. Sizdan o'qishingiz va oldingi ishingiz haqida **so'rashadi**.

sentences.text: — **Do you think** they**'ll speak** English with me?
sentences.translation: — **Sizningcha**, men bilan inglizcha **gaplashisharmikan**?

sentences.text: — Probably, yes. But your English is great — you **won't have** any problems.
sentences.translation: — Ehtimol, ha. Lekin ingliz tilingiz zo'r — hech qanday muammo **bo'lmaydi**.

sentences.text: — How long **will** it **take**, do you know?
sentences.translation: — Bilasizmi, u qancha **davom etadi**?

sentences.text: — About an hour, I expect. You**'ll be** home by lunchtime.
sentences.translation: — Bir soatcha, menimcha. Tushlikkacha uyda **bo'lasiz**.

sentences.text: — And when **will** they **tell** me their decision?
sentences.translation: — Qarorini menga qachon **aytishadi**?

sentences.text: — Usually in a week or two. **I'm sure** you**'ll get** the job!
sentences.translation: — Odatda bir-ikki haftada. **Ishonchim komil**, sizni ishga **olishadi**!

sentences.text: — Thanks, Sarah. **I shall** remember your words tomorrow!
sentences.translation: — Rahmat, Sara. Ertaga so'zlaringizni **eslayman**!

sentences.text: — Good luck! And don't forget: the traffic **will be** terrible in the morning.
sentences.translation: — Omad! Va unutmang: ertalab tirbandlik dahshatli **bo'ladi**.

examples.title: Mixed practice: life in 2050
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: will / won't, I think / I don't think, probably, so'roq va qisqa javoblar — kelajak haqidagi taxminlar.

sentences.text: By 2050, most cars **will be** electric.
sentences.translation: 2050-yilga kelib ko'pchilik mashinalar **elektr bilan yuradi**.

sentences.text: People **won't need** cash any more — everyone **will pay** by phone.
sentences.translation: Odamlarga naqd pul endi **kerak bo'lmaydi** — hamma telefon orqali **to'laydi**.

sentences.text: **Will** robots **do** all the housework? — I hope so!
sentences.translation: Uy ishlarining hammasini robotlar **qiladimi**? — Umid qilaman!

sentences.text: **I don't think** books **will disappear**; people love them too much.
sentences.translation: Kitoblar **yo'qolib ketadi deb o'ylamayman** — odamlar ularni juda yaxshi ko'radi.

sentences.text: Tashkent **will probably have** ten metro lines by then.
sentences.translation: O'shanda Toshkentda **ehtimol** o'nta metro liniyasi **bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: Do you think we**'ll live** longer than our grandparents?
sentences.translation: Sizningcha, biz bobo-buvilarimizdan uzoqroq **yashaymizmi**?

sentences.text: The summers **will get** hotter, and water **will become** more expensive.
sentences.translation: Yozlar tobora **isib boradi**, suv esa **qimmatlashadi**.

sentences.text: My children **will be** adults in 2050 — it's hard to imagine!
sentences.translation: 2050-yilda bolalarim **katta odam bo'ladi** — tasavvur qilish qiyin!

sentences.text: Children **won't go** to school; they**'ll study** at home online, some people say.
sentences.translation: Ba'zilarning aytishicha, bolalar maktabga **bormaydi**, uyda onlayn **o'qiydi**.

sentences.text: Who knows? Perhaps in 2050 **I'll be** a grandfather telling stories about smartphones.
sentences.translation: Kim biladi? Balki 2050-yilda smartfonlar haqida hikoya qilib beradigan **bobo bo'larman**.
